title: At 320 CSS px every public page overflows by 22px: the header menu button is pushed off the inline end, so a phone pans sideways and the start of every RTL line is cut
evidence: Crawl of the export at 320px (json/*-320.json): document.documentElement.scrollWidth 342 vs clientWidth 320 on all 25 public pages (admin 320/320); the only offender is button.menuButton «القائمة» at x -22..89 (text box -4.2..40.6). The bar holds Brand (Mark 36 + «أنس» + «anas.studio», site.module.css:26-43) + gap 20 + the button (padding 18+18, Mark, margin-inline-end: calc(var(--gutter) * -1 + 8px)) inside padding-inline var(--gutter)=20px; it fits only from 342px (hdr320.mjs: 334 -> button -8, 342 -> 0). Mobile emulation (isMobile, 320x568, pan320.mjs): innerWidth 342, visualViewport.pageLeft -22, name band rect 22..342, and a right-to-left swipe moves visualViewport.offsetLeft to 22: the page scrolls horizontally. Screenshot shots/mobile320-home-viewport.png shows the first letters of «أنس», «عبدالله», «القرني» cut at the right edge. Desktop 320 (400% zoom of 1280): body overflow-x: clip hides the overflow, elementFromPoint(5,30) is the button and its last letter is cut (shots/desk320-home-menubutton-x4.png, artefact: Playwright draws the RTL overflow strip on the left).
impact: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow (AA) fails at its own test width on every public page. A visitor on a 320px-wide phone (iPhone SE 1st gen, any iPhone with Display Zoom, small Androids) or at 400% browser zoom gets two-dimensional scrolling; in RTL the hidden strip is the reading start, so the opening letters of the name bands and titles sit off-screen until the visitor pans, and on desktop zoom the only navigation control (القائمة) is clipped. The visual suite runs from 360px only, so nothing catches it.
proposed_fix: Let the bar fit at 320: hide the decorative domain on narrow screens, e.g. in site.module.css `@media (max-width: 359px) { .brandDomain { display: none } }` (it is not in the link name anyway), or give .brand min-inline-size: 0 with the domain allowed to shrink. Then add 320 to the visual/overflow e2e widths.
prior_overlap: DESIGN-AUDIT D39 recheck items 43/45 claim 0px overflow at 360-1440 only; the earlier 320 attempt (prev/A11Y-RTL hdr.mjs) was cut off before reporting

title: Shift+Tab scrolls the focused control under the sticky header, which comes back on the upward scroll and hides it completely (no scroll-padding anywhere)
evidence: globals.css html{} has no scroll-padding-block-start, and grep finds scroll-padding nowhere in src (only per-section scroll-margin on four ids). SiteHeader.tsx:89-90 shows the header again on any upward scroll (y < last - 6). obscured.mjs (Shift+Tab from the end of each page, reduced motion, 1440x900): /store/demo-khous: the first variant add button rect 517,0,168,56 and its quantity input 697,0,72,56 with the header bottom at 68: 0% of either visible (shots/obscured-store_demo-khous-1440.png: rows 2 and 3 show, row 1 is under the header); /orders: input#order-recover-email rect 920,0,448,56, 0% visible (shots/obscured-orders-1440.png shows only the header, the Turnstile note and «أرسل الرابط»). The earlier attempt measured the same (prev/A11Y-RTL/shots/obscured-*-1440.png). Same cause after a successful create at 360x720 (checkout-flow.mjs with mocks): HoldView focuses the order box, the browser aligns it to the top edge and the header covers its first lines, so «رقم الطلب» and «الإجمالي» are hidden (shots/checkout-hold-360.png shows «محجوز حتى» directly under the header).
impact: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum, AA) fails: a keyboard buyer moving back up the product page or the order-recovery form cannot see which control has focus (the add-to-cart button, the quantity, the email field) and may type into or press something they cannot see. Any page whose 44-68px controls end up at the top on a backward move behaves the same; the checkout form (not renderable here) has the most fields. After «تأكيد الطلب» succeeds on a phone, the order number and total of the new order sit under the header.
proposed_fix: Add `scroll-padding-block-start: calc(var(--header-h) + 12px)` to the html rule in globals.css (the header always shows on an upward scroll), and on /book add the section bar height (e.g. `:root:has([class*=section-nav]) { scroll-padding-block-start: calc(var(--header-h) + 54px + 12px) }` or set it from SectionNav). Then the per-id scroll-margin rules become redundant.
prior_overlap: none fixed; the cut-off attempt (prev/A11Y-RTL) had the same screenshots but reported nothing

title: The scenes lightbox does not fit portrait photos: the image overflows its stage and covers the caption bar (17 of 19 photos at 1440x900)
evidence: scenes.module.css:192-205: .stage {display:grid; place-items:center; min-block-size:0} and .photo {max-block-size:100%; block-size:auto}; the percentage never resolves (the stage has no explicit row). lightbox.mjs over all 19 photos: 1440x900 17/19 taller than the 758px stage, e.g. «تحميص القهوة في رحى» img 1267x2253, bottom 2321 vs stage bottom 826, computed height 2252.83px with max-height 100% (lb2.mjs); 1024x768 16/19; 768x1024 12/19; 360x640 6/19; 320x568 7/19. document.elementFromPoint on the caption (viewerFoot) returns the IMG on 16 photos at 1440: .stage is position:relative, so the overflowing photo paints over the later, unpositioned footer. Screenshots shots/lightbox-photo4-1440.png (only the top third of the photo, the caption and its saffron category tag peek out under it) and shots/lightbox-photo4-360.png.
impact: In the gallery dialog the visitor sees a cropped top slice of most of Anas’s photos and cannot read the caption, which is the only visible text that says what the photo is (it is also the alt, so screen-reader users still get it). The dialog itself scrolls (overflow auto, scrollHeight 2321 of 900), but the caption bar stays covered by the photo wherever it is scrolled. This is /scenes, the page whose whole purpose is these photos.
proposed_fix: Give the photo a definite box: `.stage { grid-template: minmax(0, 1fr) / minmax(0, 1fr); overflow: hidden }` and `.photo { inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: contain }` (object-fit is already there), then re-run the 19-photo check at 1440x900 and 360x640.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 X3.14 fixed only the step-arrow backing; not reported before

title: «تأكيد الطلب» and the hold view's «أعد المحاولة»/«إلغاء الطلب» are `disabled` while their request runs, so keyboard focus falls to <body> and stays there on every refusal or network failure
evidence: CheckoutForm.tsx:788-790 `<ActionButton type="submit" ... disabled={!turnstileAvailable || submitting || waiting || stale || noCities || policiesStale}>`; HoldView.tsx:224, 262, 267 `disabled={submitting}`. Measured with the export and in-browser mocks of the checkout function (checkout-flow.mjs, focus-disabled.mjs; nothing left the browser): Enter on «تأكيد الطلب» -> while `create` runs document.activeElement is BODY; after a 409 QUOTE_CHANGED reply focus is still BODY (the alert «تغيّر السعر…» is announced); after a network failure, BODY again. In the hold view, Enter on «أعد المحاولة» or «إلغاء الطلب» with a failing reply: focus BODY during and after. The success paths are fine (focus moves to the order box). The P08 pages that were fixed for this keep focus with aria-disabled (OrderPage.tsx:158-159, 290, 508; PaymentReturn.tsx:190-191; NotifyAction.tsx:114-115: "aria-disabled, not disabled: the button keeps the focus while its own request runs").
impact: A keyboard or screen-reader buyer whose order is refused (price changed, policies changed, an active hold, checkout closed, a dropped connection) or whose payment retry/cancel fails hears the alert, but focus is on <body>: the next Tab starts again at «انتقل إلى المحتوى» and they must find the summary and the confirm button through the whole page, on the store's main money journey. WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order (A).
proposed_fix: Do what OrderPage already does: keep the busy buttons enabled and set `aria-disabled={submitting || waiting || undefined}` (the handlers already return early while submitting); keep `disabled` only for the states that are not the result of the buyer's own press (no Turnstile key, stale quote, no cities, policies stale), or move focus to the alert when one is shown.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 S14.5 (fixed for the success paths only); P08 R4B-02 fixed the same pattern on the order page only

title: Cart quantity «−» at 1 and «+» at 20 become `disabled` under the focus, which falls to <body>
evidence: CartView.tsx:251-274: the step buttons carry `disabled={line.quantity <= 1}` and `disabled={line.quantity >= MAX_QUANTITY}`. stepper.mjs with a mocked quote: focus on «إنقاص الكمية: خوص (تجريبي): نسخة إلكترونية» at quantity 2, Enter -> quantity 1 and document.activeElement BODY; «زيادة الكمية» from 19, Enter -> BODY.
impact: Lowering a line to one item, the most common edit in a cart, throws a keyboard user back to the top of the page (next Tab is the skip link), and a screen reader user loses their place in the line list; nothing is announced for the change except the new total. WCAG 2.4.3 (A).
proposed_fix: Keep the buttons focusable at the limits: `aria-disabled={line.quantity <= 1 || undefined}` with an early return in the handler (setQuantity already clamps), or move focus to the line's quantity field when a step reaches a limit.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 X-A11Y-RTL-6 fixed focus after removing a line; the step limits were not covered

title: The contact form's «أرسل» is disabled while sending, so focus falls to <body> after every send, success or failure
evidence: ContactForm.tsx:226 `disabled={!scripted || !turnstileAvailable || status.kind === 'sending'}`. focus-disabled.mjs (mocked contact function answering 503 after 1.2 s, Turnstile stubbed in the page): Enter on «أرسل» -> document.activeElement BODY while sending and BODY after the failure; the status line «الخدمة غير متاحة الآن؛ حاول بعد قليل.» is announced (always-mounted role=status).
impact: After sending (or failing to send) a message, a keyboard user is back at the top of the page with no focus near the form or its status; to retry they navigate the header again. Low: the result itself is announced.
proposed_fix: Same pattern as the P08 pages: `aria-disabled={status.kind === 'sending' || undefined}` on the submit (submit() already returns while sending), keeping `disabled` for the not-scripted and no-Turnstile states.
